verdict.rationale: SKILL.md descriptions do encode trigger conditions (e.g. grilling skill: 'Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking'; setup skill: 'Run once before first use of the other engineering skills'), which is the standard mechanism for context-based auto-activation in agent skill systems. However, the docs also emphasize manual invocation ('Install the ones you want, then type a slash command' and a dedicated 'Find out which skill to use for the situation you are in' meta-skill), implying activation is not fully automatic and users/agents sometimes need explicit selection help. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that the agent reliably auto-triggers the correct skill from context without manual slash commands or the meta-selector skill, and no community confirmation of trigger accuracy.
